command: set -euo pipefail; EXPECTED='eb10cdd70039e82d09cc03231b52ad851fe42546'; git fetch --no-tags origin main; test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "$EXPECTED"; gh workflow run android-ui-smoke.yml --ref main; sleep 3; gh run list --workflow android-ui-smoke.yml --branch main --event workflow_dispatch --limit 5 --json databaseId,headSha,status,conclusion,createdAt --jq '.[] | select(.headSha == "'"$EXPECTED"'") | [.databaseId,.headSha,.status,.conclusion,.createdAt] | @tsv' | head -n 1
